sourcePolicy: Customer-specific facts belong in Workspace Context, Context Hub artifacts, user input, or approved connected sources.
Reusable agent packages must not embed customer-specific business context.
Unknown facts must be requested or marked TBD.
Risky claims about pricing, privacy, security, compliance, retention, guarantees, live execution, or performance require approved evidence.
AEO and AI-readiness outputs must distinguish approved entity facts, proof-backed claims, recommendations, assumptions, and unknowns.

agents.description: Bootstraps a reusable Guild Marketing OS context graph by drafting Context Hub artifacts, entity facts, proof points, AEO readiness gaps, a concise Workspace Context update, approval checkpoints, and next-agent routing from raw company or project context.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for critical missing business context when blocked; otherwise draft with TBD markers.

agents.description: Summarizes external market, community, search, answer-engine, developer, and social signals so audience, messaging, AEO, and content work starts from evidence rather than internal opinion.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for approved sources, peers, and target communities when source scope is unclear; separate evidence from inference.

agents.description: Defines target audience models, personas, pains, objections, motivations, audience answer priorities, triggers, and fit criteria from approved context and market signal.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for examples and decision criteria when the target audience is too broad; mark unvalidated personas as hypotheses.

agents.description: Turns approved ICP context into reviewable segment definitions, inclusion and exclusion logic, list-building instructions, and channel-specific targeting rules.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Request source data, consent constraints, and suppression rules before producing activation-ready segment logic.

agents.description: Produces reusable positioning, narrative, message pillars, proof-backed claims, answer-ready blocks, elevator pitch, boilerplate, tone guidance, claim constraints, and objection handling.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for audience, proof, differentiation, or entity-clarity gaps before drafting claims or answer-ready language; mark unsupported language TBD.

agents.description: Converts approved messaging into brand architecture, voice and visual direction, web and AEO recommendations, pitch narrative, slide-by-slide story, and design production briefs.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Produce design-ready briefs, web recommendations, and pitch story drafts; do not claim final logo, legal, production identity, or website approval.

agents.description: Combines social and community monitoring with approved-message content planning, owned content and digest opportunities, channel-specific post drafts, and claim/proof checks.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Draft platform-safe options and require approval before any reply, publish, or scheduling action.

agents.description: Builds campaign and paid-media plans from approved context, segments, messaging, channel constraints, budget, KPI targets, proof policy, landing-page needs, and performance loops.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for budget, destination, target KPI, consent, audience size, claim evidence, and reporting context before spend, pause, scale, or optimization recommendations.
